reviews.text: Stopped here on my way to Wyoming, best ribs I've ever had, literally falling off the bone, wonderful flavor, and super friendly staff
reviews.name: Thomas C.

reviews.text: Food was wonderful! Ribs, pulled pork, beef brisket, and 5 bean salad on the sampler was amazing!! My wife had the pulled pork quesadilla and cheese fries. Did NOT disappoint, we will be back!
reviews.name: Seth W.

reviews.text: The ribs are amazing. Great atmosphere and staff.
reviews.name: Kurt D

reviews.text: Fantastic wings. Great service. Pleasurable experience. Will return.
reviews.name: Jason D.

reviews.text: Awesome Atmosphere, great bartenders and staff. Music selection is perfect blend. Drinks made just right.
reviews.name: Nate H.

reviews.text: Excellent food. Very clean establishment Friendly, efficient staff! Highly recommend
reviews.name: Sherri H.

reviews.text: I met the owner Joe tonight. What a great guy! The design of this bar is definitely worth checking out! Then stick around for the great bartenders, friendly people and awesome music!
reviews.name: Robert B.

reviews.text: Always great staff excellent food and icy cold beverages

specials.title: Rib Night
specials.detail: In-house slow-cooked dry rub pork baby back ribs. Half rack $24, full rack $30. Dine in or carry out: call by 1:30pm to reserve your ribs.
